instructions: Keep converter/inductor/inputcap/outputcap hotloop compact and at the HDMI perimeter, away from DDR routes.
Connect outputcaps directly between VOUT andGND with short wide copper; route quietFB from the capacitor node.
Keep SW copper small and away from RGB/TMDS/I2C/FB.
Provide a continuous ground return and nearby real groundvias; check foreignplane antipads on every throughvia.
The old5mV combined source/Ground allocation is withdrawn. Use the actual native routed-path resistance sensitivity and qualify Ground spreading, via plating and the released copper stackup.
